mechanics.name: Fake Out
mechanics.rule: Normal-type physical move, base power 40, priority +3. Works only on the user's first turn out (a switch-in, KO replacement or battle start resets it). A hit makes the target flinch if the target has not moved yet this turn.
mechanics.composite: Three rules in one move: move priority ordering, first-turn-only, and the flinch effect. Expect to split these into their own mechanics once a second move needs them (First Impression is first-turn-only, Upper Hand and Rock Slide use flinch, Quick Guard and Extreme Speed use priority).
source: showdown: data/moves.ts#fakeout (not read verbatim yet; fetch in S0)
smogon: Champions Battle Mechanics Research thread (Fake Out cannot be selected after the first turn out, reported)
repo: data/moves.json fakeout (priority 3, bp 40, contact, protect)
